messages:
Jamie (support): FYI -- ACME reporting intermittent 502/504s and streaming timeouts against hosted inference endpoint /v1/generate since ~2026-03-18T03:00Z. Customer seeing ~30% failure rate, some requests take >120s then 504. Ticket #789412.
Ravi (eng-sre): looking. Any correlation to deploys or autoscaler events? link to logs: https://internal.logs/acme/789412
Jamie (support): No deploys in window per deploy-bot. Errors cluster in us-west region, p99 latency jumped before failures.
Diego (oncall): I'm seeing connection pool exhaustion traces on edge-proxy around 02:58-03:12Z, many upstream "read timeout" and "502 Bad Gateway" from model-router.
Lena (eng-runtime): can you paste a sample request that fails? need seq_len, model, and if streaming was used.
Jamie (support): sample curl from customer: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -d '{"model":"open-rlhf-large","input":"<long prompt...>","stream":true}'
```
response: chunk closed, then 502. They also hit with short prompts and still see 502s.
Ravi (eng-sre): quick mitigation: can we route ACME to a lower-capacity fallback model variant that is lighter? reduces KV cache and runtime pressure. @Lena?
Lena (eng-runtime): Yes we can create a fallback route; I'll flip a routing rule to route the customer to `open-rlhf-medium` for 10m while we triage. Doing it now.
OpsBot: routing-change applied for customer ACME -> open-rlhf-medium (rule id r-2249)
Jamie (support): customer confirmed error rate dropped to ~3% after routing change. They're ok with a short fallback while we root cause.
Marta (prod): good. We should still find root cause and action items. Collecting notes for follow-up.
Ravi (eng-sre): Observations from logs: 1) spike in long-lived connections and slow token generation windows at the runtime layer 2) upstream queue depth maxed on model-router 3) proxy conn pool exhausted, many connections in TIME_WAIT. Hypothesis: sudden burst of large token-generation requests combined with insufficient autoscaler headroom and conservative proxy connection pool settings.
Lena (eng-runtime): Repro steps I ran: replayed a customer-like workload (mix of streaming, long prompts). On dev cluster I see model-worker CPU pegged, kv-cache churn, and increased tail latencies causing proxy backpressure -> 502.
Sam (solutions): noted that client retries were set aggressive (3 retries, no jitter) causing thundering retries. Customer SDK also had synchronous streaming client, which can backlog connections.
Diego (oncall): Immediate mitigations applied: 1) routing fallback (done) 2) bump runtime autoscaler min replicas by +20% for us-west (temporary) 3) increase proxy connection pool size +50% 4) enable short-term circuit-breaker on heavy endpoints (10s) to fail fast for pathological requests.
Lena (eng-runtime): I pushed a hotfix to reduce KV eviction churn (small config flip) and tuned tokenizer worker count on the router. Metrics show queue depth dropping.
Ravi (eng-sre): I'll follow up with a patch to backoff client-retry headers in ingress and add jitter recommendation to SDK docs. Also will open an alert on proxy connection saturation so this doesn't silently escalate.
Marta (prod): Action items for postmortem:
- (Ownership: Lena) Root-cause analysis with flame graphs from model-worker and router.
- (Ownership: Ravi) Change autoscaler policy: faster scale-up, smaller stepdowns; add proxy_conn_pool alert.
- (Ownership: Sam) Update SDK docs and recommend client retry jitter + exponential backoff; add streaming best-practices.
- (Ownership: Jamie) Customer comms: confirm SLA credit eligibility and schedule follow-up call.
- (Ownership: Diego) Run chaos test for connection pool exhaustion and autoscaler responsiveness in staging within next 72h.
- (Ownership: All) Prepare runbook update for large-batch/streaming customer patterns.
Jamie (support): customer accepted the fallback and wants ETA on permanent fix. I'll schedule call for EOD.
Lena (eng-runtime): preliminary timeline: small autoscaler and config tweaks to prod by tomorrow morning, full RC + binary patch if needed within 3 business days.
Ravi (eng-sre): assigning tickets: INF-4321 (autoscaler policy), INF-4322 (proxy pool alert), INF-4323 (postmortem doc). I'll link them here when created.
Sam (solutions): I'll send the suggested SDK retry snippet to ACME in the follow-up and add it to our public docs.
Marta (prod): thanks team. We'll treat this as P2 until postmortem complete. If anything regresses escalate to P1.
Jamie (support): closing loop with ACME: they reported short blips after fallback but overall OK. Logging final notes in ticket. Will create the postmortem doc once INF-4323 is open. :white_check_mark:
